caveats: The Q4 figure is derived from the annual and nine-month figures rather than reported directly as a standalone quarterly value.
The nine-month input comes from a different filing (accession 0000078003-25-000150) than the annual figure (0000078003-26-000026).

claims.text: Pfizer's capital expenditures (payments to acquire property, plant and equipment) in fiscal Q4 2025 were about $845 million, derived as $2,629,000,000 (FY2025) minus $1,784,000,000 (nine months ended 2025-09-28) = $845,000,000.

raw_output.summary: Pfizer's capital expenditures in fiscal Q4 2025 (2025-09-29 to 2025-12-31) were about $845 million. This is a derived value: full-year 2025 capex of $2,629,000,000 minus $1,784,000,000 for the first nine months.
